title: 第11章 混元功残第12章 书稿初成
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: “小人定当勤加练习，不负殿下期望。”
李叶青郑重承诺。莲公主点了点头，不再多言，身形一闪，又如来时般悄无声息地离开了。
书阁内再次剩下李叶青一人。
他深吸一口气，将怀中的《混元桩》取出，轻轻摩挲着粗糙的封面。
“终于……开始了。”
他没有急于开始解析或修炼，而是先将书稿收好，然后像往常一样，检查书阁，静静读着莲公主来之前正在看的那一本《堪山分水注解》。
【《堪山分水注解》解析中，解析进度31100】
直到夜深人静，月光透过窗棂洒入书阁，李叶青才在自己的小屋内，就着一点微弱的油灯，再次翻开了《混元桩》。
他凝神静气，默念一遍《清静经》之后，心中平静，神志专注，随即开始读起手中的《混元桩》。
刹那间，手中的书册仿佛活了过来，那些文字和图谱化作一道道清晰的信息流，涌入他的脑海。
不仅仅是表面的姿势和呼吸法，更深层次的、关于如何调动微弱气血、如何感应自身经脉、如何通过特定的姿势引动天地间稀薄元气淬炼体魄的原理，都被解析系统层层剥开，以一种直观易懂的方式呈现给他。
【《混元桩》解析中……解析进度1%…2%…3%…】
李叶青沉浸在这种奇妙的状态中，他能感觉到，自己对这本基础功法的理解，正在以一种恐怖的速度加深。
寻常人需要数月甚至数年才能领悟的关窍，他可能在几个时辰内就能豁然开朗。
这种状态一直持续到第二天清晨，当第一声鸡鸣响起，天边的一缕阳光投射到李叶青的脸上。
他才缓缓地合起手中的功法。
【《混元桩》解析完成，解析成果黄级中品·混元功·残，v1（31100·入门）】
“呼~果然，我猜的是对的，混元功中的许多原理都蕴藏在《清静经》中，解析《清静经》对于理解混元功助益非比寻常，甚至于直接推动了《混元桩》向着混元功蜕变，不过现在还只是残片，不知道等到清静经解析完成，混元功能不能补全。
不过在解析《清静经》之后，自己的精神头确实是越来越好，即便已熬了一夜，现在依旧不困”
既然如此，不如现在就试一试这《混元功》的效果。
心念既定，李叶青不再犹豫。
服下一枚莲公主给的血气丹。
他按照脑海中已被解析系统梳理得清晰无比的《混元功·残》法门，开始调整自己的姿态。
他双脚分开，与肩同宽，脚尖微微内扣，膝盖微屈，形成一个看似简单却蕴含玄妙的站姿——这正是混元桩的起手式。
同时，他依照特定的节奏，进行深长而缓慢的呼吸，意念尝试着引导体内那微弱得几乎难以察觉的气血，按照功法所述的简陋路线缓缓流动。
起初，一切并无异常。
他只是觉得双腿微微发酸，呼吸有些刻意的不自然。
这具身体毕竟孱弱，又受过宫刑，气血亏虚得厉害。
然而，就在他坚持了约莫一炷香的时间，心神渐渐完全沉浸其中，与《清静经》带来的那份宁静清明之感隐隐契合时，异变陡生！
他猛地感觉到，在小腹丹田的位置，似乎有一丝极其微弱的温热感觉悄然滋生！
那股温热，推动着体内的气血顺着经脉绕行，绘制出混元功的运功路线图。
身体站桩带来的酸麻感竟然减轻了不少，取而代之的是一种奇特的扎根感，仿佛双脚与地面连接得更加紧密，身体也似乎……轻盈了一丝？
content_en:
"Young man must practice diligently and live up to His Highness's expectations."
Li Yeqing solemnly promised. Princess Lian nodded, said no more, and left as quietly as she came.
Li Yeqing was once again left alone in the library.
He took a deep breath, took out "Hunyuan Zhuang" from his arms, and gently rubbed the rough cover.
"Finally... it begins."
He did not rush to start analyzing or practicing, but put away the manuscript first, then checked the bookcase as usual, and quietly read the "Annotations on Kanshan Fenshui" that Princess Lian was reading before she came.
["Annotations on Kanshan Water Dividing" is being analyzed, the analysis progress is 31100]
It was not until late at night, when the moonlight filtered through the window lattice into the bookstore, that Li Yeqing opened "Hunyuan Zhuang" again in his small room with a weak oil lamp.
He calmed down and recited the "Qing Jing Sutra" silently once. His heart was calm and his mind was focused, and he immediately began to read the "Hunyuan Zhuang" in his hand.
In an instant, the book in his hand seemed to come alive, and the words and diagrams turned into clear streams of information and poured into his mind.
Not only the superficial postures and breathing methods, but also the deeper principles on how to mobilize weak qi and blood, how to sense one's own meridians, and how to induce the thin vitality between heaven and earth to temper the body through specific postures, were all peeled off layer by layer by the analytical system and presented to him in an intuitive and easy-to-understand way.
["Hunyuan Pile" is being analyzed...The analysis progress is 1%...2%...3%...]
Li Yeqing was immersed in this wonderful state. He could feel that his understanding of this basic technique was deepening at a terrifying speed.
A key point that would take ordinary people months or even years to comprehend may suddenly become clear to him within a few hours.
This state lasted until the next morning, when the first rooster crow sounded, and a ray of sunlight from the sky fell on Li Yeqing's face.
He slowly closed the skills in his hands.
[The analysis of "Hunyuan Stake" is completed, the analysis result is yellow-level middle-grade·Hunyuan Gong·Remnant, v1 (31100·Entry)]
"Huh~ Sure enough, my guess was right. Many of the principles of Hunyuan Gong are contained in the "Qing Jing Sutra". Analyzing the "Qing Jing Sutra" is extremely helpful in understanding Hunyuan Gong. It even directly promoted the transformation of "Hunyuan Zhuang" into Hunyuan Gong. However, it is only a fragment now. I don't know that when the analysis of the Qing Jing Sutra is completed, the Hunyuan function will not be completed.
However, after analyzing the "Qing Jing Sutra", my mental state has indeed become better and better. Even after staying up all night, I am still not sleepy."
In this case, why not try the effect of this "Hunyuan Gong" now.
With his mind set, Li Yeqing no longer hesitated.
Take a blood pill given by Princess Lian.
He began to adjust his posture according to the "Hunyuan Gong·Zan" method that had been clearly sorted out by the analysis system in his mind.
His feet are shoulder-width apart, his toes are slightly tucked in, and his knees are slightly bent, forming a seemingly simple but mysterious stance - this is the starting position of Hunyuan Zhuang.
At the same time, he took deep and slow breaths according to a specific rhythm, and his mind tried to guide the weak and almost imperceptible Qi and blood in his body to flow slowly according to the simple route described in the technique.
At first, nothing was out of the ordinary.
He just felt that his legs were slightly sore and his breathing was deliberately unnatural.
After all, this body was weak and had been tortured by castration, so its energy and blood were severely depleted.
However, just when he persisted for about a stick of incense, and his mind gradually became completely immersed in it, and when he faintly matched the sense of tranquility and clarity brought by the "Qing Jing Sutra", a sudden change occurred!
He suddenly felt that there seemed to be an extremely weak warm feeling quietly growing in the Dantian of his lower abdomen!
That warmth pushes the qi and blood in the body to circulate along the meridians, drawing a road map for Hunyuan Gong.
The soreness and numbness caused by the body posture has actually been relieved a lot, replaced by a strange sense of rooting, as if the feet are more closely connected to the ground, and the body seems...a little lighter?
